whatThisTeaches: base-free normal setup with two independently seeded hidden decks
active-seat action discovery over an exact public card domain
deterministic non-human procedures modeled as ordinary reducer state
ordered public procedure events and cooperative outcome breakdowns
whenToCopyThisPattern: Use this pattern when one or two humans cooperate against a predictable rival that must not occupy a player seat.
Let automatic phases reveal, resolve, refill, and advance until the next genuine human decision.
Keep retry and reconnect idempotency in the engine rather than adding request identifiers to gameplay state.
